messages: Observational data is from historical archive (Kharif 2024, latest date 2024-09-30). Forecast product is retrospective and must be treated as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.
Multi-year validation gate is INSUFFICIENT_DATA (1 season(s) available < 5 required). Operational forecast certification requires multi-season hindcast verification.
Operational probability calibration is inactive due to sample size or event balance gatekeeper. Probabilities represent raw tree scores or diagnostic estimates.
Spatial resolution bounded at BLOCK level; localized convective micro-bursts are unresolvable.
Feature attributions reflect statistical model contributions, not physical or agronomic causality.
Input dataset is retrospective (Kharif 2024 archive). Forecast reflects historical conditions, NOT current live weather.
Historical record spans 1 season (<5 seasons required). Multi-year operational skill certification is scientifically gated.
Probabilities are uncalibrated empirical scores due to sample size constraints on operational calibrators.
